title: Selected left-extension unit and normalized counit are invertible
statement: Let B be an inverse sequence of commutative ring sheaves on a site and S a SystemLevelLeftExtensionTheory [def-pur-system-level-left-extension-basic]. For every order embedding r of the natural numbers, the actual selected-extension adjunction unit is invertible on every derived selected system N. Its counit is invertible on every derived full system M for which every transition-adjoint, for every m≤n, is invertible. No normalization of N, flatness of coefficients, or boundedness is assumed.

source.place: Construction 4.1; Proposition 5.24; integral scalar mates, proof step 2.

proof.text: Minimality and strict monotonicity give t(r(n))=n. Tensor at the identity coefficient map is naturally isomorphic to the identity. Hence the scalar adjunction at that map is an equivalence, and its Hom transpose carries isomorphisms to isomorphisms. Apply selectedDerivedTranspose to the identity of L_r(N); its left side is invertible. Its right side is the evaluated unit followed by the evaluation comparison and the identity transition. The last two factors are invertible by transition_identity and the scalar unitor. Cancel them and use detectsIso to prove the actual unit is invertible.

source.place: Construction 4.1; Proposition 5.24; integral scalar mates, proof step 2.

proof.text: Apply selectedDerivedTranspose to the actual counit. Its adjunction transpose is the identity by the triangle identity. Transpose the formula back through the scalar adjunction; the evaluated counit, preceded by selectedDerivedBelow inverse, equals derived tensor applied to the selected evaluation comparison, followed by the normalized transition-adjoint. This composite is invertible. Cancel the comparison and apply detectsIso.
